Philadelphia Stars Community Paint Day

Philadelphia Stars Negro League Baseball Mural design (detail) by David McShane, displayed at the 2026 Major League Baseball All-Star Village on July 11, 2026. Photo by Elijah Dreuitt.

Come help paint the new Philadelphia Stars Negro League Baseball Mural! The cloth panels that we paint will be installed on the wall at the Miller Parker Philadelphia Stars Negro League Memorial Park in the spring of 2027.

Designed by muralist David McShane, the new artwork expands upon a 2005 mural that was lost to development. Grab a paint brush and help us revive an important tribute to Philadelphia’s Black baseball history!
